category: DDL release index (scene releases with direct host links)

free_tier.stated: Free to read with no account: /feed/ served 40 RSS items and the post page carried three direct host links. No fee, no registration, no captcha on the pages read.

per_object_cap.stated: not applicable: an index of release posts, not a store of bytes

retention.stated: Posts remain until removed. The feed carries the 40 most recent items; the home page carries the bare counter 3,600,609 beside 'Latest releases', whose unit the page does not label.

egress.terms: No byte allowance and no traffic counter: the index serves HTML and XML. The bytes come from whichever host the post links to (nitroflare.com, ddownload.com and multiup.io in the post read).

interface_detail: WordPress RSS 2.0 at /feed/ (content-type application/rss+xml, 40 items, generator wordpress.org/?v=7.1.3), per-category feeds, and HTML search. The WordPress JSON API is closed: /wp-json/wp/v2/posts?per_page=2 returned 401 Unauthorized, and /api returned 404. The feed is the only machine interface.
tooling: Any RSS reader or a short script. The feed's description carries release text rather than links, so host links still require the post page.
chaining: Poll /feed/ for new releases, filter on group and size, open the post, then hand the nitroflare or ddownload link to a debrid service or a download manager.

limits.value: no published limit; 10 sequential requests about 1.3 s apart and 8 concurrent requests all returned 200, with no 429 and no Retry-After

limits_note: The forum is a separate login.
binding_note: An index holds no bytes to meter, so the only constraint a user meets here is the page rate while enumerating posts. None was observed at about 0.8 req/s; the per-host quotas behind the links belong to the storage topic.

identity_cost.detail: No account, cookie or captcha on the feed or the post read. The comment form asks for a name and email; reading does not.

reliability_note: Cloudflare in front. A post carries only the hosts that still hold the file, and the three links in the post read are the whole set, with no mirror beyond what the post shows.
confidence_note: Feed, post and robots.txt were fetched on 2026-10-23. An hour of polling recorded through probe would raise this to measured.

evidence.proved: content-type application/rss+xml, 40 item entries, lastBuildDate Fri, 23 Oct 2026 01:39:15 +0000, generator wordpress.org/?v=7.1.3
direct nitroflare.com, ddownload.com and multiup.io links rendered to an anonymous reader, with size 29.32 MB and an NFO
HTTP 401 Unauthorized, so the WordPress REST API is not an open route and RSS is the feed that works

notes: The strongest DDL-side feed: machine-readable, no account, and the post page hands over host links without a login. Candidates considered and rejected as the primary path: rlsbb.cc (robots.txt forbids the crawl), ddlbase.com (two mirrors then a login), 0daydown.com (VIP gate). The site's own JSON API is 401, which is why RSS rather than JSON is the answer.
